title: Best-of-Majority: Minimax-Optimal Strategy for Pass@k Inference Scaling
authors_zh: Qiwei Di、Kaixuan Ji、Xuheng Li、Heyang Zhao、Quanquan Gu（加州大学洛杉矶分校）
paper_type_zh: 测试时推理扩展理论与数学推理评测论文（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 设计 pass@k 评测、奖励模型选择或有限推理预算分配的研究者。
one_line: Best-of-Majority gives a minimax-optimal, scaling-monotonic way to allocate sampled candidates under a Pass@k inference budget.
Best-of-Majority 在有限采样和提交预算下，以频率筛选结合奖励排序实现可随样本数稳定扩展的 pass@k 推理策略。
why: It separates the sampling budget, submission budget, and reward-model error rather than treating more samples as an automatic gain.
inclusion_reason: It formalizes how pass@k performance should scale with sampling and submission budgets, making test-time compute allocation auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Repeated sampling can improve a reasoning system only if it also knows which answers to submit. Majority voting trusts frequency, while best-of-N trusts a reward model; under a Pass@k contract, either can keep nonzero regret or even worsen as the sampling budget grows.

The paper asks for a selection rule that jointly respects the number of generated candidates and the number of answers a system may return. Its target is not a prettier single-answer score, but a rule whose performance improves predictably when more inference compute is spent.

重复采样只有在系统还能判断应提交哪些答案时，才能提升推理能力。多数投票相信答案出现频率，而最佳候选选择相信奖励模型；在 Pass@k 约束下，两者都可能保留非零遗憾，甚至会随着采样预算增加而变差。

本文寻求一种同时考虑生成候选数量和允许返回答案数量的选择规则。它的目标不是得到一个更好看的单答案分数，而是让额外的推理计算能够带来可预测的性能提升。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Best-of-Majority first uses repeated samples as evidence about which responses are sufficiently supported by the reference policy. It removes rare candidates before consulting the reward model, so an isolated high reward cannot by itself promote a response that the generator almost never produces.

Among the surviving candidates, the method returns the highest-scored subset permitted by the Pass@k budget. Frequency supplies a conservative coverage filter and the reward model supplies a quality ranking; combining them is intended to preserve the strengths of voting and reranking without inheriting their worst-case failures.

最佳多数法首先把重复采样视为参考策略是否充分支持某个回答的证据。它在查询奖励模型之前移除罕见候选，因此一个孤立的高奖励不能仅凭自身推动生成器几乎从不产生的回答。

在保留下来的候选中，该方法返回 Pass@k 预算允许的最高分子集。频率提供保守的覆盖过滤，奖励模型提供质量排序；这种结合旨在保留投票和重排序的优势，同时避免它们在最坏情形下的失败。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each prompt, the method samples N responses, counts equivalent answers, and keeps only those whose empirical frequency exceeds a threshold. It then evaluates that reduced set with an imperfect reward model and submits at most k responses with the best predicted rewards.

The analysis defines regret against the best ground-truth reward available in the sampled pool and makes reward error and policy coverage explicit. The authors derive a matching lower bound, choose the threshold and sampling regime accordingly, and compare the procedure with majority voting and best-of-N on mathematical reasoning tasks.

对于每个提示，该方法采样 N 个回答，统计等价答案，并只保留经验频率超过阈值的候选。随后，它用不完美的奖励模型评估这个缩小后的集合，并提交至多 k 个预测奖励最高的回答。

分析把遗憾定义为相对于采样池中最佳真实奖励的差距，并明确刻画奖励误差和策略覆盖度。作者推导出匹配的下界，据此选择阈值和采样范围，再在数学推理任务上将该过程与多数投票和最佳候选选择比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper proves that its regret upper bound matches a minimax lower bound for the stated Pass@k setting. Under its assumptions, this makes Best-of-Majority minimax optimal and scaling-monotonic, whereas the analysis constructs cases in which majority voting and best-of-N do not improve monotonically with a larger sampling budget.

Experiments on mathematics problems support the theoretical comparison: the reported curves show Best-of-Majority outperforming the two baselines as sampling is scaled. This is evidence about a particular selection contract with a reward model, not a claim that every verifier or every open-ended task will show the same curve.

论文证明，在其设定的 Pass@k 情形下，该方法的遗憾上界与极小极大下界相匹配。在这些假设下，这使最佳多数法具有极小极大最优性和随规模单调提升的性质；相反，分析构造出多数投票和最佳候选选择不会随采样预算增大而单调改进的情形。

数学题实验支持这一理论比较：报告的曲线显示，随着采样规模扩大，最佳多数法优于两种基线。这证明的是带奖励模型的特定选择约定，并不意味着每个验证器或每类开放式任务都会出现同样的曲线。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not simply another vote or reranker. It formalizes the multi-submission Pass@k setting, separates generation budget from submission budget, and asks whether a rule is safe to scale rather than merely strong at one hand-tuned number of samples.

Its central design move is to use sample frequency as a guardrail for reward-model selection. Earlier pipelines often choose between voting and reward ranking; this work turns their interaction into an algorithm with a stated regret guarantee and an explicit account of reward error and coverage.

这项贡献并不只是又一种投票或重排序方法。它形式化了可多次提交的 Pass@k 设定，区分生成预算和提交预算，并询问一条规则是否能安全扩展，而不是只在某个手工调出的采样数量上表现强劲。

其核心设计是把样本频率用作奖励模型选择的护栏。早期流程常在投票和奖励排序之间二选一；本研究把二者的交互变成带有明确遗憾保证的算法，并显式说明奖励误差和覆盖度的影响。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The guarantees require a particular Pass@k abstraction, a reference policy with useful coverage, and a reward model whose error fits the analysis. Frequency can discard a rare but genuinely correct answer, while reward ranking can still fail when the surviving candidates exploit scorer mistakes. The mathematical experiments do not settle costs for long free-form responses, semantic equivalence detection, or domains where several valid answers are expressed differently. A deployment should therefore report the equivalence rule, candidate count, submission count, reward-model version, and total generation and scoring cost.
这些保证依赖特定的 Pass@k 抽象、具有有效覆盖度的参考策略，以及误差符合分析条件的奖励模型。频率可能丢弃罕见但确实正确的回答，而奖励排序仍可能在保留候选利用评分器错误时失败。数学实验并不能解决长篇开放回答、语义等价识别或多个有效答案表述不同的领域中的成本问题。因此，实际部署应报告等价规则、候选数量、提交数量、奖励模型版本以及生成和评分的总成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a system may generate many solutions but can submit only a limited number for evaluation, such as a Pass@k coding or mathematics workflow. Keep the candidate budget N, the submission limit k, the answer-normalization rule, and reward-model calls fixed when comparing it with majority vote or best-of-N. It is most useful for readers who need to decide whether extra samples are buying coverage, being spent on unreliable reranking, or both; it is not a substitute for training a better generator or auditing the verifier.
当一个系统可以生成许多解答、却只能提交有限数量供评估时，例如 Pass@k 的代码或数学流程，可以使用这项工作。与多数投票或最佳候选选择比较时，应固定候选预算 N、提交上限 k、答案规范化规则和奖励模型调用。它最适合需要判断额外样本是在购买覆盖度、花在不可靠的重排序上，还是两者兼有的读者；它不能替代训练更好的生成器或审计验证器。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as a budget-allocation and selection result, not as evidence that sampling alone is a universal scaling law. The useful audit table has four columns: N generated responses, k submitted responses, the frequency threshold, and the reward-model error or calibration. The key empirical question is whether a gain remains after those quantities and all scorer calls are counted. The theory is especially valuable because it supplies counterexamples to the attractive but unsafe assumption that simply increasing best-of-N must help.
应把本文读作预算分配和选择结果，而不是把它当成采样本身是普遍标度律的证据。实用的审计表应有四列：生成回答数 N、提交回答数 k、频率阈值，以及奖励模型误差或校准情况。关键的实证问题是，当这些量和所有评分器调用都计入后，收益是否仍然存在。该理论尤其有价值，因为它为“只要增加最佳候选数就一定有帮助”这一诱人但不安全的假设提供了反例。
